description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). L(k LONG primary key) with keys 1..1200 inserted ascending: enough entries to split the tree into several leaves. Then Close, and the bytes of pages 44 to 53 (where the table's index pages land) are read from the closed file. Asks the stored prefix of each index leaf.
